title: Figure 33: Evaluation of Object Sightings in Strategic Areas of the Central East Region
description: Regional map of the US mid-Atlantic and Northeast with heavily outlined, cross-shaped strategic areas around New York, Harrisburg and Washington, each labeled with its count of object sightings (e.g., "Washington 146 object sightings"). Dashed leader lines link each area to a pie chart of evaluation categories (Astro, Aircraft, Balloon, Insuf. info., Other, Unknown), and a separate pie gives the "Balance of Central East Region". Latitude and longitude lines are marked. Caption: "FIGURE 33 COMPARISON OF EVALUATION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS IN THE STRATEGIC AREAS OF THE CENTRAL EAST REGION"; drawing B-7511.
